name: @ui8kit/theme-model
description: The global theme model of the apps (ADR-0001, apps layer: the brand theme an app assembles): one skin, font, default radius and per-element tokens (radius, density, shadow) for a whole site, the field schema both theme views render, export/import of the config (format `magazine-theme` v2, THEME_SCHEMA), the root style and attributes, and storage under the app's own key (the Magazine `magazine:v1:theme`, Stock `stock:v1:theme`). Moved from apps/magazine/src/lib (global-theme.ts, design.ts, tokens.ts: a skin's colour tokens probed from the CSS); controller.ts: the ThemeController contract the shared Theme sheet (@ui8kit/layouts/theme) reads. Plain TypeScript, no UI, no build step.
